name: Shield of the Ages' buff reduces damage taken and caps at three stacks (#3391)
contract: Shield of the Ages 804444's tooltip is "When hit by a damaging critical strike, your damage taken is reduced by $804445s1%, and healing received is increased by $804445s2% for $804445d, stacking $804445u times". Its only effect is aura 42 (SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL) on 804445, whose effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN -3 (applied in Unit::SpellDamageBonusTaken) and whose effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_HEALING_RECEIVED_PCT +5, with duration index 27 (3000 ms) and StackAmount 3. Spell.dbc gives 804444 ProcFlags 0x0 and no spell_proc row existed, so the buff was never granted. The proc trigger itself cannot be asserted in this harness: it requires an incoming CRITICAL melee or spell hit, the harness has no way to force a creature to crit, a hostile player attacker is unavailable (CoAGameplayTest.cpp has no PvP-flag or player-faction support and Unit::_IsValidAttackTarget requires it), and a base creature crit rate makes a long-window assertion fail roughly half the time. What this scenario does prove deterministically is the buff's own numbers - the values the spell_proc row makes reachable - by fixturing 804445 directly.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Learning the talent alone grants no Shield of the Ages buff
Incoming spell damage without the buff
One stack of Shield of the Ages reduces damage taken by about 3%
Shield of the Ages stacks three times, as StackAmount 3 requires
Shield of the Ages lasts 3 seconds
